**Finding resubmitted: Compliant** — no redline, no comment.

The verifier's two failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause at all in this Agreement — there is no duration or carve-out to measure. I repaired the finding by:

- **Strengthening the citation** — the quote is now the operative text of § 8(c) rather than the bare section heading, showing that "employees" there serves only an access-restriction covenant and imposes no hiring restraint.
- **Documenting the negative search set** — "solicit", "solicitation", "no-hire", "poach", "employ", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "personnel", "staff", "leave the employ" all return nothing beyond § 7 (Unsolicited Commercial E-Mail) and the incidental § 12 indemnity references.
- **Explaining the failed checks on the record** so they are not misread as a defect, and noting the fallback is unnecessary.
- **Carrying forward the reviewer note** that § 8(d)'s cross-reference to the separate Non-Competition Agreement is scoped to TrueLink's Credit Data licence, not personnel, and that any hiring restriction in that separate instrument falls outside this document and warrants its own diligence.

Outcome is unchanged and favourable to us: the absence of any non-solicit is our preferred position, so we take no action rather than importing a mutual covenant.
